text:
maya: us-west-2 GLB healthchecks showing ~20% unhealthy on gpu-pool-alpha, packet loss and long-tail latencies. I'm going to reduce weight now.

ops-bot: [ALERT] GLB: endpoint gpu-pool-alpha in us-west-2 failing health checks (20% unhealthy) at 1710581234

maya: @chen can you confirm if this is an infra deploy or a network blip?

chen: looking at node metrics — GPU mem pressure + OOM-kills on several nodes, kernel logs show pcie errors. Not a deploy.

sam: network team flagged a spine switch flapping earlier, but it's stable now. suspect hardware -> failing over capacity.

maya: ok. plan: shift 60% traffic off us-west-2 to us-east-1, 30% to eu-west-1, keep 10% for canary. applying GLB weight change.

liam: runbook says update routing policy via control plane. use the API to adjust region weights and set gradual ramp.

maya: applying now (curl)...

maya: ```
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.internal/glb/policies/traffic-shift \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GLB_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"policy":"weighted","regions":{"us-west-2":0.1,"us-east-1":0.6,"eu-west-1":0.3},"ramp_seconds":60}'
```

deploy-bot: [GLB] policy update accepted (policy id: shift-2026-03-15-01)

chen: i'm cordoning failing nodes in us-west-2 nodepool-alpha and starting reprovisioning.

sam: i can increase dedicated spare capacity but that will spin up new instances in us-west-2 — slower. prefer routing out.

maya: agree. keep reprovisioning but route traffic away for now.

liam: monitoring: start synthetic checks and tail p50/p99 on tokens. if errors drop, we keep weights. if not, escalate.

ops-bot: [SYNTH] us-east-1 p99 latency spike resolved after weight shift — 200ms -> 120ms

maya: noting cost impact — more cross-region egress for eu users now. tag traffic shift for cost analysis.

chen: reprovisioning started, expected ~20 min for node replacements.

sam: also flagged quota reserve in us-east-1 is 85% used — adding buffer now.

maya: can we enable prefix caching to reduce cross-region tokens while this is happening?

chen: enabled KV prefix cache on GLB edge for eu-west-1 -> should cut egress by ~30% for embeddings workload.

maya: good. i'll update incident channel and runbook. postmortem to include hardware and regional capacity plans.

liam: once stable, we'll do a controlled rollback of weights to original over 10 min window.

maya: thanks all. ping here when nodes are healthy.

chen: nodepool alpha shows 100% healthy at 1710581920, kernel errors cleared.

maya: rolling weights back to baseline now (ramp 600s).

deploy-bot: [GLB] policy update accepted (policy id: shift-rollback-2026-03-15-02)

ops-bot: [INCIDENT] resolved: us-west-2 degraded capacity — traffic shifted and reprovisioned

sam: postmortem party when we close the ticket :party_parrot:

maya: filing postmortem PR against infra/runbooks with recommended spare capacity thresholds and healthcheck tuning.
